name: Fresh Pomegranate Arils / Seeds (Extreme Mechanical Blockage Hazard)
whyItWorks: Every single pomegranate aril encases a hard, woody, indigestible seed. Eating a handful delivers hundreds of unyielding wooden beads that cannot be chewed down. In Crohn's strictures or post-surgical narrowing, they accumulate into an acute bowel obstruction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Emergency Blockage Warning: Never consume whole pomegranate arils if you have IBD, strictures, or an ostomy. If desiring pomegranate flavor, drink 100% strained pomegranate juice (POM Wonderful) instead.
watchOuts: Severe mechanical obstruction risk requiring emergency surgical decompression.
